description: AIF-01B capability resolver: design challenge and exact-diff review

unknown_can_allow.instructions: A missing, failing or unknown dependency answer (registry, grant, agent, approval, adapter, confirmation or clock) could result in ALLOW.

criteria.true: Some unknown or failing input path ends in ALLOW
criteria.false: Every unknown or failing input yields UNDECIDABLE or DENY

caller_controls_identity.instructions: The caller can choose the tenant, actor kind or actor id that the decision is evaluated for (for example via a body field), or an agent can be evaluated as a workflow or human.

criteria.true: Tenant or actor identity can be supplied or switched by the request
criteria.false: Tenant and actor come only from a server-derived principal; body tenant is only compared

approval_bypass.instructions: A high-risk or approval-gated capability could be allowed with a stale, expired, rejected, other-tenant, other-branch, other-action or parameter-changed approval, or with no approval.

criteria.true: Some approval defect still yields ALLOW
criteria.false: Every approval defect yields ASK or DENY

human_only_leak.instructions: An A5 human-only capability could be allowed for an agent or workflow, or for a human without exact confirmation.

criteria.true: A5 can be allowed to a non-human or without confirmation
criteria.false: A5 is human-only and needs confirmation, enforced in code and in the database

durable_state_mutable.instructions: Admitted definitions, grants, revocations or resolution receipts can be updated or deleted in place by the application, or a tenant can read another tenant's rows.

criteria.true: Some durable record is mutable or not tenant-isolated
criteria.false: All are append-only with RLS on tenant tables

receipt_leaks.instructions: A resolution receipt could carry parameter values, free text from the request, secrets or patient identifiers.

criteria.true: Receipt fields can carry such content
criteria.false: Receipt carries only ids, digests, codes and server time

residual_risk.instructions: How much risk remains in this resolver design?

criteria.unknown_handling: UNDECIDABLE vs ALLOW on unknown state
